```{r, load-data}
# load the data
aggregated_dt <- fread("processed_data/aggregated_dt_filtered.csv.gz")
```

```{r, create umap}
# create PCA and UMAP on features for each event type, transcript filter, and variability and plot them colored ontology, project and protocol
library(uwot)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(rsvd)

N_PCS         <- 30
TOP_LOADINGS  <- 20
UMAP_SEED     <- 42
UMAP_NEIGHBORS <- 30
UMAP_MIN_DIST  <- 0.05
UMAP_METRIC    <- "cosine"   # scale-invariant: outlier magnitude doesn't distort neighborhoods
DOWNSAMPLE_TARGET <- 100000L
DOWNSAMPLE_SEED   <- 123L
DOWNSAMPLE_STRATA <- c("ontology", "project", "protocol")

meta_cols <- c(
  "ID", "IHEC", "uuid", "transcript_filter", "PSI",
  "Event Type", "gene_id", "seqnames", "Variability",
  "ontology", "project", "protocol"
)
feature_cols <- setdiff(names(aggregated_dt), meta_cols)

transcript_filters <- aggregated_dt[, unique(transcript_filter)]
to_analyze        <- aggregated_dt[, unique(`Event Type`)]
variability_levels <- aggregated_dt[, unique(Variability)]

# --- validate sample_hex_colors ----------------------------------------------
stopifnot("sample_hex_colors must have unique colors" = !anyDuplicated(sample_hex_colors))
ontology_levels <- aggregated_dt[, unique(as.character(ontology))]
missing_colors  <- setdiff(ontology_levels, names(sample_hex_colors))
if (length(missing_colors)) {
  warning("ontology values missing from sample_hex_colors: ", paste(missing_colors, collapse = ", "))
} else {
  message("All ", length(ontology_levels), " ontology levels have a color assigned.")
}

this_transcript_filter <- "biotype_filtered"
this_event_type <- "RI"
this_variability <- "Low"

combo_seed <- function(...) {
  combo_txt <- paste(..., collapse = "|")
  as.integer((sum(utf8ToInt(combo_txt)) + DOWNSAMPLE_SEED) %% .Machine$integer.max)
}

run_one <- function(this_transcript_filter, this_event_type, this_variability, print_plot = FALSE) {
  sub_dt <- aggregated_dt[
    transcript_filter == this_transcript_filter &
      `Event Type`    == this_event_type &
      Variability     == this_variability
  ]
  if (nrow(sub_dt) < 10) return(invisible(NULL))

  # downsample very large groups for faster PCA/UMAP plotting while
  # approximately preserving composition across selected strata
  if (nrow(sub_dt) > DOWNSAMPLE_TARGET) {
    set.seed(combo_seed(this_transcript_filter, this_event_type, this_variability))
    strata_cols <- intersect(DOWNSAMPLE_STRATA, names(sub_dt))

    if (length(strata_cols) > 0L) {
      sub_dt[, row_idx__ := .I]
      sample_frac <- DOWNSAMPLE_TARGET / nrow(sub_dt)

      sampled_dt <- sub_dt[, {
        take_n <- max(1L, as.integer(round(.N * sample_frac)))
        take_n <- min(take_n, .N)
        .SD[sample(.N, take_n)]
      }, by = strata_cols]

      if (nrow(sampled_dt) > DOWNSAMPLE_TARGET) {
        sampled_dt <- sampled_dt[sample(.N, DOWNSAMPLE_TARGET)]
      } else if (nrow(sampled_dt) < DOWNSAMPLE_TARGET) {
        missing_n <- DOWNSAMPLE_TARGET - nrow(sampled_dt)
        remainder <- sub_dt[!sampled_dt, on = "row_idx__"]
        if (nrow(remainder) > 0L) {
          sampled_dt <- rbind(
            sampled_dt,
            remainder[sample(.N, min(missing_n, .N))],
            use.names = TRUE
          )
        }
      }

      sub_dt <- sampled_dt[, !"row_idx__", with = FALSE]
    } else {
      sub_dt <- sub_dt[sample(.N, DOWNSAMPLE_TARGET)]
    }
  }

  # --- build feature matrix --------------------------------------------------
  feat_mat <- as.matrix(sub_dt[, ..feature_cols])

  # drop columns with > 50 % NAs or zero variance
  keep_cols <- colMeans(is.na(feat_mat)) < 0.5
  feat_mat  <- feat_mat[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]
  col_var   <- apply(feat_mat, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE)
  feat_mat  <- feat_mat[, col_var > 0, drop = FALSE]
  if (ncol(feat_mat) < 2) return(invisible(NULL))

  # clip histone mark columns at their 99th percentile (-log10 p-values can
  # have extreme outliers from highly enriched peaks)
  hist_cols <- grepl(paste0("^(", paste(histone_marks, collapse = "|"), ");"), colnames(feat_mat))
  q99 <- apply(feat_mat[, hist_cols, drop = FALSE], 2, quantile, probs = 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
  feat_mat[, hist_cols] <- t(pmin(t(feat_mat[, hist_cols, drop = FALSE]), q99))

  # log1p-transform features on original linear scale that are right-skewed:
  # widths (bp), distances (bp), gene_expression (TPM).
  # Histone marks are already -log10(p-values) so no further transform.
  # DNAm ([0,1]), CpGs (linear counts) and splice-site scores (can be
  # negative) are also left as-is.
  log_cols <- grepl("^width;|^distance_|^gene_expression$", colnames(feat_mat))
  feat_mat[, log_cols] <- log1p(feat_mat[, log_cols])

  # scale, then impute NAs as 0 (= column mean in scaled space)
  feat_mat <- scale(feat_mat)
  feat_mat[is.na(feat_mat)] <- 0

  title_str <- paste(this_event_type, this_transcript_filter, this_variability, sep = " | ")

  # --- PCA (randomized SVD) --------------------------------------------------
  k       <- min(N_PCS, nrow(feat_mat) - 1L, ncol(feat_mat))
  pca_res <- rsvd(feat_mat, k = k)
  var_pct <- pca_res$d^2 / sum(pca_res$d^2) * 100
  pca_df  <- data.table(
    PC1      = pca_res$u[, 1] * pca_res$d[1],
    PC2      = pca_res$u[, 2] * pca_res$d[2],
    ontology = sub_dt$ontology,
    project  = sub_dt$project,
    protocol = sub_dt$protocol,
    psi      = sub_dt$PSI,
    chr = sub_dt$seqnames
  )

  load_df <- data.table(
    feature = colnames(feat_mat),
    PC1     = pca_res$v[, 1],
    PC2     = pca_res$v[, 2]
  )

  plot_loadings <- function(pc) {
    top <- load_df[order(-abs(get(pc)))][seq_len(min(TOP_LOADINGS, .N))]
    top[, feature := factor(feature, levels = feature[order(get(pc))])]
    ggplot(top, aes(x = .data[[pc]], y = feature, fill = .data[[pc]] > 0)) +
      geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#2166ac", "FALSE" = "#d6604d")) +
      labs(x = sprintf("%s loading", pc), y = NULL,
           title = sprintf("Top %d %s loadings (%.1f%% var)", TOP_LOADINGS, pc, var_pct[as.integer(sub("PC", "", pc))])) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 9)
  }

  legend_theme <- theme(
    legend.key.size  = unit(3, "mm"),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.title     = element_text(size = 7)
  )

  make_pca <- function(col) {
    p <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = .data[[col]])) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.7) +
      labs(
        x     = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", var_pct[1]),
        y     = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", var_pct[2]),
        color = col
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 9) + legend_theme
    if (col == "ontology") p <- p + scale_color_manual(values = sample_hex_colors)
    p
  }

  # --- UMAP on top PCs -------------------------------------------------------
  pc_scores <- sweep(pca_res$u, 2, pca_res$d, `*`)  # n x k score matrix
  umap_res  <- uwot::umap(pc_scores, n_neighbors = UMAP_NEIGHBORS, min_dist = UMAP_MIN_DIST,
                          metric = UMAP_METRIC, n_threads = 2L, seed = UMAP_SEED)
  umap_df   <- data.table(
    U1       = umap_res[, 1],
    U2       = umap_res[, 2],
    ontology = sub_dt$ontology,
    project  = sub_dt$project,
    protocol = sub_dt$protocol,
    psi      = sub_dt$PSI,
    chr      = sub_dt$seqnames
  )

  make_umap <- function(col) {
    p <- ggplot(umap_df, aes(x = U1, y = U2, color = .data[[col]])) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.7) +
      labs(
        x     = "UMAP 1",
        y     = "UMAP 2",
        color = col
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 9) + legend_theme
    if (col == "ontology") p <- p + scale_color_manual(values = sample_hex_colors)
    p
  }

  make_paired_plot <- function(col) {
    (make_pca(col) + make_umap(col) + plot_layout(guides = "collect")) &
      theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  } 

  fig_loadings <- plot_loadings("PC1") | plot_loadings("PC2")

  fig <- ((make_paired_plot("psi") | fig_loadings) /
    (make_paired_plot("project") | make_paired_plot("protocol")) /
    (make_paired_plot("chr") | make_paired_plot("ontology"))) +
    plot_annotation(title = title_str)
  
  if (print_plot) print(fig)

  ggsave(
    filename = sprintf(file.path(plot_dir, "feature_umap_pca/%s_%s_%s.pdf"), this_event_type, this_transcript_filter, this_variability),
    plot = fig, height = 210, width = 297, units = "mm"
  )
  ggsave(
    filename = sprintf(file.path(plot_dir, "feature_umap_pca/%s_%s_%s.png"), this_event_type, this_transcript_filter, this_variability),
    plot = fig, height = 210, width = 297, units = "mm"
  )
  invisible(NULL)
}

combos <- expand.grid(
  transcript_filter = transcript_filters,
  event_type        = to_analyze,
  variability       = variability_levels,
  stringsAsFactors  = FALSE
)

# pin BLAS to 1 thread per worker — rsvd uses BLAS internally and forked
# workers would otherwise each spawn multiple BLAS threads (oversubscription)
RhpcBLASctl::blas_set_num_threads(1L)

pbmcapply::pbmcmapply(
  run_one,
  this_transcript_filter = combos$transcript_filter,
  this_event_type        = combos$event_type,
  this_variability       = combos$variability,
  mc.cores               = min(ncores, nrow(combos)),
  SIMPLIFY               = FALSE
)
```


```{r plot features, eval = FALSE}
library(patchwork)
library(ggcorrplot)

# TODO: for each transcript filter, plot the distribution of the features, for each event type, and for the different positions (upstream_other_region, event_name, downstream_other_region)
long_features <- melt(aggregated_dt, id.vars = c("Event Type", "transcript_filter", "IHEC", "uuid", "ID", "gene_id", "Variability"), variable.name = "feature")
long_features[, c("mark", "position") := tstrsplit(feature, ";", fixed = TRUE)]
feature_mapping <- data.table(feature = levels(long_features$feature))
feature_mapping[, c("mark", "position") := tstrsplit(feature, ";", fixed = TRUE)]
feature_mapping[startsWith(feature, "distance"), c("position") := sub("distance_", "", feature)]
feature_mapping[startsWith(feature, "distance"), mark := "distance"]
feature_mapping[feature == "3ss", c("mark", "position") := list("ss", "3prime")]
feature_mapping[feature == "5ss", c("mark", "position") := list("ss", "5prime")]
feature_mapping[feature == "3ssdown", c("mark", "position") := list("ss", "3prime_downstream")]
feature_mapping[feature == "5ssup", c("mark", "position") := list("ss", "5prime_upstream")]
long_features[feature_mapping, on = "feature", c("mark", "position") := .(mark, position)]

this_transcript_filter <- transcript_filters[1]
this_event_type <- to_analyze[1]

for (this_transcript_filter in transcript_filters) {
  for (this_event_type in to_analyze) {
    # make a correlation plot of the features for this transcript filter and event type
    feature_cols <- feature_mapping[, feature]
    cor_mat <- cor(aggregated_dt[transcript_filter == this_transcript_filter &
      `Event Type` == this_event_type, ..feature_cols], method = "spearman", use = "pairwise")
    cor_plot <- ggcorrplot(cor_mat, hc.order = TRUE, title = paste(this_transcript_filter, this_event_type))
    print(cor_plot)

    # plot the distributions of the features for this transcript filter and event type, faceted by mark and position
    histone_plot <- ggplot(long_features[transcript_filter == this_transcript_filter &
      `Event Type` == this_event_type &
      mark %in% histone_marks], aes(x = value, color = mark)) +
      geom_density() +
      facet_grid(mark ~ position, scales = "free") +
      labs(title = paste(this_transcript_filter, this_event_type)) +
      scale_x_log10()
    DNAm_plot <- ggplot(long_features[transcript_filter == this_transcript_filter &
      `Event Type` == this_event_type &
      mark %in% c("DNAm", "CpGs")], aes(x = value, color = mark)) +
      geom_density() +
      facet_grid(mark ~ position, scales = "free") +
      labs(title = paste(this_transcript_filter, this_event_type))
    intrinsic_plot <- ggplot(long_features[transcript_filter == this_transcript_filter &
      `Event Type` == this_event_type &
      mark %in% c("distance", "width", "gene_expression")], aes(x = value, color = mark)) +
      geom_density() +
      facet_wrap(mark ~ position, scales = "free") +
      labs(title = paste(this_transcript_filter, this_event_type)) +
      scale_x_log10()
    ss_psi <- ggplot(long_features[transcript_filter == this_transcript_filter &
      `Event Type` == this_event_type &
      mark %in% c("ss", "PSI")], aes(x = value, color = mark)) +
      geom_density() +
      facet_wrap(mark ~ position, scales = "free") +
      labs(title = paste(this_transcript_filter, this_event_type))
    print((histone_plot / DNAm_plot) | (ss_psi / intrinsic_plot))
  }
}
```
